name: Repetitive Prayer
overview: Scripture teaches that repetitive prayer should not be practiced as vain or empty repetition, as Jesus warns against using many words to be heard like the heathen (Matthew 6:7). Instead, prayer is to be sincere and focused, exemplified by the Lord's Prayer which is concise and reverent (Matthew 6:9). Yet, Jesus Himself prayed the same words multiple times during His time of trial, showing that repetition in prayer can express earnestness and persistence (Matthew 26:44). Moreover, prayer involves a spiritual mindset, seeking life and peace through communion with God rather than mere outward display (Romans 8:6; Luke 6:12).
